item.title: CVE-2026-131651 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.4 | The rtMedia for WordPress, BuddyPress and bbPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'media_title' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.7.18 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The vulnerability is only triggerable via the Backbone.js-rendered "Load More" pagination path; the server-side PHP gallery rendering correctly escapes media_title with esc_attr() and is not affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-19793 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Saturday 21 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | The WP Import Export Lite plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Limited Code Injection in all versions up to, and including, 3.9.32 via the 'comment' parameter. This is due to a two-stage shortcode check that evaluates the raw mapping placeholder before data substitution, causing the neutralizer to be skipped when attacker-controlled comment content containing a malicious [wpie_function] shortcode is substituted at runtime. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary PHP callables on the server. Exploitation requires an Administrator to perform the standard Export With Settings For Import followed by a New Import migration workflow, which is a routine operational task; the attacker themselves requires no account or authentication, needing only the ability to submit a pending comment on any comments-open post.

item.title: CVE-2026-134126 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | WPC Smart Messages for WooCommerce plugin before 4.3.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers with Contributor or Author privileges to disclose arbitrary post meta and private product data by supplying attacker-controlled id and key attributes to the [wpcsm_product_field] and [wpcsm_product_data] shortcodes without any capability or protected-meta checks. Attackers can embed these shortcodes in a published post to exfiltrate sensitive order data such as billing email, phone, and address stored as post meta, as well as private or draft product descriptions and purchase notes, exposing confidential customer and business information to unauthenticated site visitors.

item.title: CVE-2026-54026 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.6, POST /api/messages/:conversationId authorizes req.params.conversationId in api/server/middleware/validateMessageReq.js but persists attacker-controlled req.body.conversationId through api/server/routes/messages.js. An authenticated attacker can use an owned conversation in the URL while naming a victim conversation in the body, causing an attacker-controlled message to be stored in the victim conversation. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.6.

item.title: CVE-2026-54038 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.9, GET /api/permissions/search-principals passes the q parameter to JavaScript RegExp construction and MongoDB regex queries in packages/data-schemas/src/methods/userGroup.ts findGroupsByNamePattern and searchPrincipals without escaping metacharacters. An authenticated user with people-picker permission can submit a catastrophic-backtracking pattern that blocks the Node.js event loop and makes the service unresponsive to concurrent users; invalid patterns can also produce server errors. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.9.

item.title: CVE-2026-134136 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8
item.description: Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8 | OceanWP WordPress Theme before 4.2.9 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the oceanwp_edd_terms_list() function in inc/edd/edd-helpers.php, which allows authenticated users with EDD download category creation permissions to inject malicious JavaScript by crafting a category name that breaks out of an unescaped HTML title attribute. item.title: CVE-2026-134163 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | probe-image-size 7.4.0 contains a regular expression denial of service vulnerability in lib/common/svg_header.js that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to block the event loop via crafted SVG doctypes. item.title: CVE-2026-134170 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2
item.description: Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2 | Cesanta Mongoose 7.22 before 7.24 with the built-in TLS stack contains an out-of-bounds read in mg_timegm() that allows remote attackers to crash the process via crafted X.509 certificate validity months. item.title: CVE-2026-134171 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Cesanta Mongoose 7.21 before 7.24 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in rx_ip6() checksum validation that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to read past received packets by sending IPv6 extension headers. item.title: CVE-2026-134172 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5

item.title: CVE-2026-16132 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description:
Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Icon API: Menu submodule of the Drupal 7 Icon API module. When a menu item is configured with the Title Wrapper option enabled, the value of the Title Wrapper Class field is output directly into an HTML attribute without sanitization or escaping. A user with the "administer menu icons" permission can inject a payload such as `title" onmouseover="alert(document.cookie)` that is rendered verbatim on every page displaying the affected menu item, executing arbitrary JavaScript in the browser of any user who interacts with the menu link. This can lead to session theft, account hijacking, and further attacks against site users.
This issue affects Icon API 7.1.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-19030 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description:
Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Observable Discrepancy vulnerability in Drupal CAPTCHA for Drupal 7 allows unauthenticated attackers to test login credentials despite CAPTCHA protection.
When CAPTCHA is enabled on Drupal login forms, normal form validation can still run after a missing or incorrect CAPTCHA response. This may expose credential validation feedback and allow an attacker to distinguish invalid credentials from valid credentials paired with a failed CAPTCHA.
This issue affects CAPTCHA for Drupal 7: from 7.x-1.0 through 7.x-1.7.
